{# Page scaffold. A section registers itself as it renders, and the table of contents is built from what registered -- so a section id and its TOC entry cannot drift apart, and `section scrollspy` is spelled in exactly one place. Import these `with context`: they read `toc_sections` off the context. section(id, label) heading is the label section(id, label, heading=false) no heading (intro sections) section(id, label, heading="...") heading text differs from the TOC entry section(id, label, tag="h2") heading level other than h3 #} {% macro section(id, label, heading=None, tag="h3") %} {%- do toc_sections.append({'id': id, 'label': label}) -%}
{%- if heading is not false %} <{{ tag }}>{{ heading if heading is not none else label }} {%- endif %} {{ caller() }}
{% endmacro %} {# Extra, non-section entries (an off-site link, say) go in a {% call toc() %}. #} {% macro toc() %}

  • {{ s.label }}
    • {%- endfor %} {{- caller() if caller }}

  • s for the table of contents. #} {% macro page_body(toc_extra=None) %}
